propositions: When a plan re-enters review with a LATEST BLOCK verdict and unchanged description fingerprint, the system must warn if blocking findings' cited text anchors remain verbatim in the current plan, before running the review.
The cited-anchor pre-check must be deterministic (no LLM) and warn-only, never hard-blocking or changing exit codes, because ~8% of BLOCK→PASS flips occur with no material changes.

Anchors that cannot be matched verbatim (paraphrased evidence, structural findings without quotes) must never trigger the warning alone; warning fires only when at least one anchor matched old text and all matched anchors are untouched.
The pre-check must record precheck.cited_anchor_warning (true or false) in the review sidecar metrics on every plan review to enable offline measurement of warning hit rate and predictive value.
